Subject: Post-call recap: Marketplace integration & next-stage tech deep dive

Thanks again for the conversation this morning — good momentum. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth.

Recap (high level)
- CloudMaestro wants a marketplace-listed integration that can route customers to dedicated Redwood deployments (hosted + dedicated) and optionally surface usage-based billing.
- Primary technical asks: auth model (SAML/OAuth), sample manifest for marketplace listing, and a lightweight PoC that proves token routing + attribution.
- Timeline ambition: internal pilot in Jan, public listing in Q1.

Immediate next steps
1) 60–75 minute technical deep dive (engineers + partner integration lead) — go over API auth, model variants, and test tenant setup.
2) Mutual action plan (runbook) draft attached (MAP_v0.9.xlsx). Please review and flag gaps.
3) Share names/emails for the engineers you want on the deep dive; we’ll include our infra and integrations owners.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue 2026-12-08: 10:00–11:15 or 14:00–15:15
- Wed 2026-12-09: 09:00–10:15 or 13:00–14:15

If none of those work, please send 2–3 alternatives or use the calendly link below. I’ll circulate a detailed agenda once we lock time.
